'''Gray Eight''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Garik Loran]], later [[Wraith Eight (callsign)|Wraith Eight]], prior to [[Wraith Squadron|Gray Squadron's]] adoption of its permanent designation, Wraith Squadron.<ref name="XWWS" />

During the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] [[Mission to Storinal|mission]] to [[Storinal]], Loran was again designated "Gray Eight" for the task of commandeering a pair of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] with [[Atril Tabanne]] at the [[Revos Spaceport]]. The Wraiths' cover blown, the TIEs were instead destroyed by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Falynn Sandskimmer]], and Loran and Tabanne were picked up by Wraith Squadron's shuttle [[Narra (shuttle)|''Narra'']].<ref name="XWWS" />
